notes.title: Steam Achievements!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]
[b]Now, in Mr. Sweet, achievements are added!
Many of you asked about this :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/457f73c3f47062fca6e5bdf709073a504b211a71.png[/img]

At the moment, 20 achievements, maybe later we'll add more :)

Enjoy the game[/b]

notes.title: Hello Friend!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Friend! We have a small request :)[/h1]

If you like "Mr. Sweet", please leave a review in the store.
We remembered this late and now the game has fallen very low in the lists: (
We are creative people and we have bad marketing :D

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/46fc6884c4cb0e5ae1eaf9514e1b1243bf6654b0.png[/img]

[i]Thank you very much for being with us! 
Mr. Sweet has few players, so we know practically all of them))[/i]

notes.title: Release? Release!
notes.content:
[b] [h1] We're done! This is our first release on Steam and we hope that you were satisfied :) [/h1]
[img] https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/3b10a95ae6c1712a451cab6384a9d52bc402c53b.jpg [/img]
Thanks to everyone who supported and guided us, you are great fellows!
The list of changes will not be, because there is nothing significant.
At the moment we are working on a new game (about knights, but this is inside information) and will be glad to see you again!

[i] If there are any wishes or comments on Mr. Sweet - do not hesitate to share with us, we will do everything:) [/i]
[/b]

notes.title: Okay, one more update. 0.8.8
notes.content:
[h1]Well, if you're interested:[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/5ad2c55e86a8e336afbdcfc796e8018728a7244c.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Increased the collection area of the coin bonus "Collector"
[*]Added new levels
[*]New platforms added
[*]Added new traps
[*]Changed some platforms
[*]Notification of the next level opening
[*]Added game cursor
[*]Reduced prices for some characters
[*]Increased speed of movement between the running lines
[*]In some levels, the speed of the character's run is reduced
[/list]

We went to drink Russian vodka
Have a nice day

notes.title: Update 0.7.3! Hell, we're close
notes.content:
[h1]Hi, I'm George and I came to show a cool picture:[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/af5009745bcf8fffbd968ce5c798edcd990c17bb.png[/img]

[b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6lBq11qLLWA]Teaser[/url][/b]

[h1]The list of changes today will be brief[/h1]

[i][b]A new universe is open: Fast Food World[/b][/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/d5254cabfdbee6c3b9067d794f1f332378a24c79.png[/img]

[i][b]Added 2 new levels to the first universe[/b][/i]

[i][b]New music: The Multiverse (and it has a low price)[/b][/i]

[i][b]Redesign of the pause menu[/b][/i]

[i][b]Many bug fixes[/b][/i]

[i]A huge number of small and boring changes, for this reason I will not mention them :)[/i]

notes.title: Whaaaaat?! Update 0.4.6?! Yes
notes.content:
[h1]So, what did we add:[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/2e0b582dda18ed298bd55486d7d03e9a02e6854d.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b] Added a new trap: Bomb on the floor [i](and it's adorable)[/i] [/b]

[*][b] Countdown at the beginning of the level is now animated [/b]

[*][b] Treason the form of some barricades, now you will crash a little less but still a lot [/b]

[*][b] Completely remade the main menu [/b]

[*][b] Added new music: The Colony [/b]

[*][b] Added new music: Heavy Wave [/b]

[*][b] Added preview of levels [/b]

[*][b] The distances needed to open new levels are reduced [/b]

[*][b] Added the ability to use superpowers on the right Shift [/b]

[*][b] Huge heads now move their teeth not synchronously [/b]

[*][b] The initial speed is slightly reduced and the height of the usual jump is increased [/b]

[*][b] Fixed a bug when simultaneously pressing both Shift keys the abilities were triggered twice, sometimes it was funny, it's a pity that you will not see it [/b]

[*][b] Reduced the cost of music [i](all music)[/i] [/b]

[*][b] Added a little bit of optimization and increased the number of simultaneously existing platforms. Now it looks like they were always there, and did not appear in front of your nose just now [/b]

[*][b] Some unpleasant things will not bother you in person anymore [/b]
[/list]

[i] And many more small and boring changes [/i]

notes.title: Big Bad Bomb! (Will be in the next update)
notes.content:
Well, we rested a week after the release. 
[b]Yes, we did not do anything for a week at all.[/b] In my opinion it's great, but it's time to get down to business! 

[b]And the first thing we did was a huge bomb![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/54f0d6639309aa5f50814f1fa82f489bac9a69ae.jpg[/img]

[h1]Soon we will publish changelist :)[/h1]

notes.title: Update 0.4.0!
notes.content:
[h1]The first update is always exciting, but we will try not to cry![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/38be5c62839a34141efc393cc0460a9db1351629.png[/img]

[b]*Added new character: Mr. Maven[/b]

[b]*Added character descriptions[/b]

[b]*Added abilities to characters:[/b]
[i]Mrs. Sweet - Sweet jump[/i]
[i]Candy Police - Sweet sprint[/i]
[i]Mr. Zombie - DONUTS! (You eat a donut-barricade and get 15 coins for each)[/i]
[i]Ninja - Ghost mode[/i]
[i]French Fries - Emergency stop[/i]
[i]Mr. Erudite - Jetpack[/i]
[i]Mr. Tunod - Sweet double (the first "Shift" to create a clone, the second "Shift" to move to it)[/i]
[i]Mr. Maven - Sweet magnet[/i]
[i]Mr. Evil Baking - Laundering of sweetcoins (5 coins for 1)[/i]

[b]*Added new music[/b]

[b]*Reduced prices for characters and music in the store[/b]

[b]*Improved system of collisions, now you will hit less often :)[/b]

[b]Changed the coins icon in the menu[/b]

[b]*Changed some types of platforms[/b]

[b]*The height of the standard "jump" is changed[/b]

[h1]We wish you a pleasant game![/h1]
